Council approves the new bridge

Staff writer · Tuesday

The council voted on Tuesday to approve the river crossing after a decade of debate. Construction is expected to begin next spring and take three years.

Opponents said the cost had doubled since the first estimate; supporters answered that the old bridge is closed to lorries and that the detour costs the town more every year.
